{{Quote|Hoping to impress me so much that I'll persuade the Ruling Circle to let you handle the Qoribu problem?|[[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]], to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="DN1" />}}
The '''Ruling Circle''',<ref name="DN1" /> also known as the '''Chiss Ruling Circle''',<ref name="CSWE Nirauan">{{CSWECite|II|384|Nirauan}}</ref> or the '''Ruling Council''' was the governing body of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The membership of the Ruling Circle was selected from the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]].<ref name="CSWE Ruling Families">{{CSWECite|III|115|Ruling Families}}</ref>
